name: Result

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: A discriminant selects one active Ok(T) or Err(E) payload. The inactive side is not a value.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: Result<T,E>(Ok(value)) | Result<T,E>(Err(error)). isOk/isErr distinguish variants. get/expect observe Ok; getErr/expectErr require Err. The measured value-form map(43), mapErr(47), andThen(Ok(53)) and orElse(Ok(61)) preserve the selected payload type; arbitrary effectful callbacks are not implied.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: Owns the active T or E. Propagation selects the active error route and does not implicitly discard live resources.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Wrong-side observers and incompatible fallback/callback types reject in the bounded profile. Imported metadata cannot supply executable payloads. The executed target is x86_64 Linux System V ELF; no foreign ABI layout is implied.

summary: A typed success or failure with one active payload.
